test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f769fc4621f63fdb330b23c083cd8351d88e21632fa537f0bd132631c0531f8.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) The line outside the star - It is shifting in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/372decfcc258406c488954cd2af87a6597857de0372324a695b321317fe835c1.png] 

2) The line inside the star - It is shifting in the anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49effe93ec8226b33f4131b8c8608ea61a4927aea68da5c0dceedc1ed89c4850.png] 

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
